item.description:
OhNine 2.0: rebuilt as a native Mac app

  • About 5 MB, one download for Apple silicon and Intel
  • Signed and notarized by Apple, updates itself from now on
  • Syncs through claude.ai's own API in well under a second
  • No more random "sign in" prompts
  • Several Claude accounts, a workspace picker and usage credits
  • A notification the moment your session resets
  • Liquid Glass and a 3D Claw'd who trudges home at the limit

Sign in once more after updating.
